title: Skill Tree Prerequisites
description: There are a total of numCourses courses you have to take, labeled from 0 to numCourses - 1. Some courses may have prerequisites, for example to take course 0 you have to first take course 1, which is expressed as a pair: [0,1]. Given the total number of courses and a list of prerequisite pairs, return true if you can finish all courses. Otherwise, return false.
constraints: All the prerequisite pairs are unique.
input_format: Integer numCourses and a 2D integer array prerequisites.

examples.explanation: Total courses are 2. To take course 1 you should have finished course 0. So it is possible.
Total courses are 2. You need to take course 1 before course 0, and course 0 before course 1. This creates a cycle.
Only one course with no prerequisites.
